entities.summary: Nadejda Constanza Ivanka Gavrila Euphrosyna Stancioff Muir, also known as Nadezhda Stanchova Muir, was a Bulgarian diplomat and translator. She was the first woman to officially represent Bulgaria in the diplomatic field and participated in international peace conferences after World War I. She became the wife of a Scottish baronet.
